title: gpt-image-2
prompt:
Primary request: A vertical mobile infographic poster, warm cream paper background (#f7f2e8), editorial magazine style. Title at top in bold black Chinese: '三道裂缝' with English subtitle 'Three cracks in the viral story'. Three numbered cards stacked vertically, each with a simple flat icon and a short Chinese headline + one-line takeaway:
Card 1 (red accent): icon of a judge gavel. Headline: '评委不是 AI'. Takeaway: '真正在打分的是像素 diff 和测试，不是另一个大模型。'
Card 2 (blue accent): icon of parallel arrows colliding. Headline: '并行会翻车'. Takeaway: '18 个合并冲突，缺陷分 13→39→14，从没回到起点。'
Card 3 (gold accent): icon of an unreachable mountain peak. Headline: '游戏从没赢过'. Takeaway: '每一轮评委都选了真的 CoD，渐近线不是终点线。'
Clean modern flat illustration, generous whitespace, thin gold dividers, highly readable Chinese typography (use Source Han Sans / PingFang style), no watermark, no photorealism.
